title: sheynkmanlab/lrp2 pipeline - params.input schema (BAM input)
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input (PacBio BAM files)

sample_name.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

bam.errorMessage: BAM file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam'

bam_id.errorMessage: BAM ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces. This should match the name in the BAM header (e.g., BioSample_1)

condition.errorMessage: Condition must be provided and cannot contain spaces

replicate.errorMessage: Replicate label must be provided and cannot contain spaces
